candidate_terms.hemoglobin_low: Admission hemoglobin below 12; not low if not measured
candidate_terms.prior_admits: Network admissions in the 12 months before this one: one, or two or more, against none
candidate_terms.sodium_low: Admission sodium below 135; not low if not measured
candidate_terms.weekend_discharge: Discharged on a Saturday or Sunday
candidate_terms.winter_discharge: Discharged in December, January or February

development_population: Medicine-service discharges from Tonmick University Medical Center, 1 January to 30 June 2022, with a complete admission laboratory panel (sodium, creatinine, hemoglobin, white cell count, lactate). Each patient's first such discharge in the period.
eligible_discharges: Alive, to home, home with home health, or skilled nursing. Not deaths, hospice, discharges against advice or transfers.
fictional: Tonmick Health and this model are invented. Nothing here describes a real hospital, team or model.
intended_use: Rank adult discharges by risk of an unplanned readmission within 30 days, so that discharge planners can follow up the highest first. Shown on the discharge-planning worklist at every hospital from 2023-02-01.
method: Each candidate term was tested alone in a logistic model and kept when p < 0.20 on a likelihood-ratio test. The terms kept were then fitted together. Risk is the logistic function of the intercept plus the sum of coefficient times value.
missing_values: In production a laboratory value that was not measured counts as not low.
outcome: An unplanned admission to a Tonmick Health hospital within 30 days of discharge. A return flagged as planned does not count.
